title: Amazon Verified Permissions with AWS Lambda
description: Deploy an AWS Lambda function URL that authorizes requests with Amazon Verified Permissions Cedar policies, using the caller's IAM identity.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A client sends a SigV4-signed request to an AWS Lambda function URL with AWS_IAM authentication. The function reads the caller's IAM principal from the request context, maps it to a role on the server, and calls the Amazon Verified Permissions IsAuthorized API.

Four Cedar policies (admin, reader, document owner, and a confidential-document deny) make the fine-grained decision. The request body supplies only the action and the resource, never the principal, role, owner or classification.
See the README for signed curl requests that show ALLOW and DENY decisions.
